# Locally served interface assets

These are the same versions previously loaded from external CDNs:

- Bootstrap 5.3.2 CSS: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v5.3.2
- Font Awesome Free 6.5.0 CSS and fonts: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/tree/6.5.0

Upstream licenses are included beside each package. Bootstrap JavaScript is not
needed: the interface uses native controls and its own navigation handlers.
Keeping CSS and fonts local allows navigation without contacting a CDN.
